text: Focus the project path input when the website opens without a project
description: When opening the website with no project selected (for example http://localhost:4000/), automatically focus the project path input so the user can start typing immediately. Currently no field is focused on page open.

status.comment: 2c0b75d8: ProjectSelectionView focuses its input on mount (covers opening without a project and Switch Project). Verified in the rebuilt bundle: activeElement is .project-input on http://localhost:4000/. Awaiting Felix's acceptance.
